description: High-level dual-path inference architecture showing request flow from client through OpenShift Route to the inference gateway, which routes to either Intel Xeon 6 (CPU path) or Intel Gaudi (GPU path). Includes KServe ServingRuntimes, model cache PVCs, and Prometheus monitoring.
visual_elements: CPU Path: Xeon 6 → vLLM CPU → Granite/CodeLlama models
GPU Path: Gaudi → vLLM Gaudi → Llama Scout/DeepSeek models
KServe ServingRuntime labels on each path
demo_context: Used in the Architecture Explainer profile to demonstrate vision-language understanding of complex system diagrams.
